Name: Fridge Link
Author: Malenyaaa
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]When you cook, the game only uses ingredients from your inventory, the fridge and mini fridges in the same house. With this mod you can link any chest to the kitchen, wherever it stands, and cooking uses its ingredients too.[/color]

Open a chest and click the fridge button below the organize button. A linked chest shows the fridge brightly, an unlinked one shows it faded. Click again to unlink.

This mod was written with the help of an AI coding assistant. I came up with the idea, decided how it should behave, tested it in-game and reviewed the result.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Install the latest version of SMAPI.
2. Download this mod and unzip it into your Mods folder.
3. Run the game using SMAPI.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]- Link any normal or big chest to the kitchen with one click in the chest menu.
- Cooking uses ingredients from all linked chests, no matter where they stand.
- Links are saved with the chest and stay after reloading.
- Works with and without Better Crafting. With Better Crafting, linked chests are added to its cooking menu.
- Fridges, mini fridges and special chests (like the Junimo chest) can't be linked.
- Translations: English, German.
- Open source (MIT): https://github.com/Malenyaaa/stardew-mods[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]- SMAPI (required): https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400
- Better Crafting (optional, supported): https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11115[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to Pathoschild for SMAPI and the mod build tools, and to KhloeLeclair for Better Crafting.[/color]
